This checks the finite coefficient and equality interface, conditional on the written universal row premises and exact internal assignment.

checks.scope: Doubled-P10 arbitrary-support isolation and final counting.
checks.method: Read doubled-P10.md and the complete-C5 synchronization argument; independently tested all 56 nonempty support traces of size at most 4 for the claimed two-block witness.
checks.observation: All 56 traces admit A,B with A∩B=A∩S=B∩S. For the ten traces that are P10 blocks, A=B is necessary; distinct outside centres still make the lifted members distinct, as the proof requires. Extra members containing a centre are handled separately by link isolation. Remaining members avoid both centres and the P10 support; two disjoint ones would form an empty-core sunflower with a prescribed cone, so H27 applies. Inclusion-exclusion gives 27+16+16-3=56 without double-counting the twenty prescribed members. Checks and source hashes are preserved under checks/round09/alpha/; no broad replay was run.
